items.reply: Changed to FP/none: the userId filter is accurately described, but widening authorization is not justified by this flow. getConnectedDestinationCalendars.ts:282-290 already limits database credentials to the session user, and credential.ts:226 assigns userId to persisted delegation credentials. The code therefore does not establish a legitimate team-owned credential rejected by this action; the issue draws an unsupported defect conclusion from a real filter.
